explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and only fires at GO, right after the previous trial chose a1, reached S1 by the common transition, and got no reward (most often the first loss after a run of a1 wins). It reaches about 10 when the agent stays with a1 late in the episode (trials 75-85), about 8 on a second loss in a row, about 5-6 earlier in the episode, and about 0-2 if the agent switches to a2 or the unrewarded trial was rare or an a2 choice.
